Notes: ADVENTURE-LOOK (10 Oct). The ground of the isometric field (iso_field.gd). Zone: path = the rows down the middle of the lane, lane = the rest of the lane where the players run, edge = the first rows outside it, outside = everything beyond. Several rows for one zone are picked at random by Weight; the same spot always gets the same tile. Biome * = every biome without its own rows. PixelLab isometric tiles 64 x 64; the top diamond is 64 x 32.
